name: Sibbecai
title: One of David's Mighty Warriors from Hushah
summary: Sibbecai was a Hushathite and one of King David's mighty warriors. He is best known for killing the Philistine giant Saph (also called Sippai), a descendant of Rapha among the giants. He also served as commander of one of David's monthly military divisions.

keyEvents.title: Killed the Philistine Giant Saph
keyEvents.description: Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph (Sippai), who was among the descendants of the giants (the Rephaim), and the Philistines were humbled.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned Among David's Mighty Men
keyEvents.description: Sibbecai the Hushathite is listed among David's thirty mighty warriors, an elite group of brave soldiers who served the king.

keyEvents.title: Commander of the Eighth Monthly Division
keyEvents.description: Sibbecai the Hushathite was appointed as leader of the military division that served in the eighth month, with 24,000 men under his command.

keyEvents.title: Battle Against the Philistines at Gob
keyEvents.description: In one of the repeated battles between Israel and the Philistines at Gob (Gezer), Sibbecai showed his courage by defeating the giant and securing victory for the Israelites.
